title: Week 07 - Arrays and Table Data
description: Practice array reading, modification, swapping, traversal, copying, and state recording.

questions.title: Read the Score of a Student at a Given Position
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Simple

## Background

The teacher stores student scores in an array scores. Each position corresponds to one student's score.

## Task

Return the score of the student at position index.

## Input

One array scores and one number index.

## Output

Return the value at position index in scores.

## Hint

Each position in an array can be accessed by its index.

questions.title: Modify the Points for One Day in a Daily Points Table
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Simple

## Background

The points a player earns each day are stored in the array points. One day's point record is wrong and needs to be changed to newValue.

## Task

Change the points for day day to newValue, then return the updated points for that day.

## Input

One array points and two numbers: day and newValue.

## Output

Return the updated points for day day.

## Hint

After finding the matching position, you can directly update the data there.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(points, day, newValue)
    points[day] = newValue
    return points[day]
end

questions.title: Swap the Data at Two Positions in a Student Line
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Simple

## Background

Student numbers in a line are stored in the array students. The teacher wants to swap the students at positions a and b.

## Task

Swap the data at two positions in the array and return the swapped array.

## Input

One array students and two numbers: a and b.

## Output

Return the students array after the swap.

## Hint

When swapping two positions, you can use a temporary variable.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(students, a, b)
    local temp = students[a]
    students[a] = students[b]
    students[b] = temp
    return students
end

questions.title: Traverse a Score Sheet and Count Passing Students
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Normal

## Background

The teacher stores the scores of n students in the array scores. A score of 60 or above is passing.

## Task

Traverse the score sheet and count how many students pass.

## Input

One array scores and one number n.

## Output

Return the number of passing students.

## Hint

When traversing the array, check the score at one position each time.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(scores, n)
    local count = 0

    for i = 1, n do
        if scores[i] >= 60 then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end

    return count
end

questions.title: Copy a Class Score Sheet as a Backup
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Normal

## Background

The teacher wants to copy the score sheet scores so the original data will not be lost if the original score sheet is modified later.

## Task

Generate a new array backup that stores the same data as scores.

## Input

One array scores and one number n.

## Output

Return the copied backup array.

## Hint

To copy an array, put each position's data into the new array one by one.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(scores, n)
    local backup = {}

    for i = 1, n do
        backup[i] = scores[i]
    end

    return backup
end

questions.title: Add an Event Bonus to Every Item in a Daily Coin Table
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Normal

## Background

A game holds an event, and each day's coin reward increases by bonus. The original coin records are stored in the array coins.

## Task

Increase every day's coin value in coins by bonus and return the updated array.

## Input

One array coins, one number n, and one number bonus.

## Output

Return the updated coins array.

## Hint

Apply the same update to every position in the array.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(coins, n, bonus)
    for i = 1, n do
        coins[i] = coins[i] + bonus
    end

    return coins
end

questions.title: Generate a Daily Accumulated Points Table for Upgrade Progress
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Challenge

## Background

The points a player earns each day are stored in the array points. To view upgrade progress, a new accumulated points table needs to be generated.

## Task

Generate the array totals, where totals[i] is the sum of points from day 1 through day i.

## Input

One array points and one number n.

## Output

Return the accumulated points array totals.

## Hint

Traverse the daily points while recording the total points so far.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(points, n)
    local totals = {}
    local sum = 0

    for i = 1, n do
        sum = sum + points[i]
        totals[i] = sum
    end

    return totals
end

questions.title: Generate the New Line Order After a Team Turns Around
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Challenge

## Background

Student numbers in a line are stored in the array students. After the teacher says to turn around, the original last student becomes first, and the original first student becomes last.

## Task

Generate the new array after the team turns around.

## Input

One array students and one number n.

## Output

Return the reversed line array.

## Hint

The front positions of the new array can come from the back positions of the original array.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(students, n)
    local result = {}

    for i = 1, n do
        result[i] = students[n - i + 1]
    end

    return result
end

questions.title: Record Who Has the Ball After Each Round in a Passing Game
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Challenge

## Background

n students stand in a circle and play a passing game. The ball starts with student start. Each round, the ball is passed forward by steps positions, and we need to record who has the ball after each round.

## Task

Simulate rounds rounds of passing and return an array recording the student number holding the ball after each round.

## Input

Four numbers: n, start, steps, and rounds.

## Output

Return an array recording which student has the ball after each round.

## Hint

When the position passes the last student, it needs to wrap back to the start of the line.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(n, start, steps, rounds)
    local record = {}
    local position = start

    for i = 1, rounds do
        position = position + steps
        while position > n do
            position = position - n
        end
        record[i] = position
    end

    return record
end
